page.overview:
Who is Belias?

Belias (65px), also known as Velius, and who refers to himself as the Devil, is the second Lucavi demon whom Ramza Beoulve must fight in Final Fantasy Tactics. He is associated with the Aries auracite, yet is a Virgo as a gameplay unit just like his host.

Belias is one of the Lucavi, a supernatural demonic race originating from another dimension connected to the world of Ivalice. Although it is uncertain whether he participated in his leader Ultima's initial effort to sow chaos in Ivalice during the prevailing period of the Holy Ydoran Empire, according to the legend of the Zodiac Braves, she intended to gather her companions through the auracites that Ultima supposedly created through her host, Ajora Glabados. However, she was ultimately prevented from achieving her goal due to Ajora's capture and execution due to her treacherous disciple, Germonique.

1200 years after Ultima's defeat and imprisonment within the body of her vessel, the twelve auracites that Ajora and his disciples were said to have wielded as the Zodiac Braves have been scattered throughout Ivalice, which was once again at war, this time between two duchies vying for the throne and control of the kingdom. The conflict became known as the War of the Lions, and was behind the scenes being orchestrated by Hashmal through his vessel, the Knight Templar Folmarv Tengille, to fulfill one of the main requirements of a complex ritual to resurrect Ultima. He also searched for the remaining Zodiac Stones and gave some of those he had found to potential vessels who could be possessed by his brethren so they could help him with his plans. Because the Church of Glabados had distorted the story of Ajora's life to conceal his true nature, his devotees were unaware of the Stones' ability to possess their bearers. In Belias's case, the Aries auracite was given as a "gift of goodwill" to Wiegraf Folles, the former leader of the disbanded Corpse Brigade, after he became a Knight Templar.

Wiegraf was unaware of the powers within the Aries Stone. During the Knights Templar's attack on Orbonne Monastery to steal the Virgo Stone, Ramza Beoulve defeated Wiegraf who dragged himself out of the church to die. The Stone arose from his cloak and offered Folles deliverance from death should he give himself over to the Lucavi. Wiegraf agreed and Belias possessed him, revealing unto Wiegraf the powers of the Lucavi. Before Ramza could engage him, Belias teleported away.
